name: garchi-cms
description: Build and manage structured websites and applications with Garchi CMS using AI agents, official starter kits and a production MCP integration.

interface.shortDescription: Structured content backend for sites and apps built by AI agents.
interface.longDescription: Garchi CMS is a headless CMS for structured content: spaces, pages built from reusable section templates, data items with categories and metadata, and assets. This plugin bundles three skills — orchestrating a build, rendering Garchi content in a frontend, and operating content over MCP — together with the hosted Garchi MCP server so the agent can read and write the user's live content.
defaultPrompt: Build a marketing site with Garchi CMS as the content backend.
Create the About and Pricing pages in my Garchi space.
Render my Garchi pages in this frontend.
